=SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t), '[]'::jsonb) AS channels
FROM (SELECT c.id AS channel_id, c.name, c.platform, c.target, c.secrets, c.template,
             pc.body_override
      FROM pub_post_channels pc
      JOIN pub_channels c ON c.id = pc.channel_id AND c.status = 'active'
      WHERE pc.post_id = {{ $('Prepare').first().json.post_id }} AND pc.status = 'pending'
      ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id) t

=INSERT INTO pub_post_channels (post_id, channel_id, status, platform_post_id, error, published_at)
SELECT {{ $json.post_id }}, {{ $json.channel_id }}::bigint, {{ $json.status_q }},
       {{ $json.pid_q }}, {{ $json.err_q }},
       CASE WHEN {{ $json.status_q }} = 'ok' THEN now() ELSE NULL END
WHERE {{ $json.channel_id }}::bigint IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (post_id, channel_id) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status, platform_post_id = EXCLUDED.platform_post_id,
  error = EXCLUDED.error, published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at
RETURNING post_id

=UPDATE pub_posts p SET
  status = CASE WHEN cnt.ok > 0 AND cnt.fail = 0 THEN 'done'
               WHEN cnt.ok > 0 THEN 'partial'
               ELSE 'failed' END,
  last_error = CASE WHEN cnt.ok = 0 THEN
               CASE WHEN cnt.fail > 0 THEN 'all channels failed'
                    ELSE 'no publishable channels' END
               ELSE NULL END,
  updated_at = now()
FROM (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS ok,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS fail
      FROM pub_post_channels WHERE post_id = {{ $('Prepare').first().json.post_id }}) cnt
WHERE p.id = {{ $('Prepare').first().json.post_id }}
RETURNING p.id AS post_id, p.status AS post_status
